title: InfluencerCheck Lens
description: A lens is a values filter expressed as concrete, observable signals. Lenses are applied by a human reviewer; the app never scores an account on its own.

id.description: kebab-case identifier; must match the file name.

description.description: One or two sentences. Describe the pattern of content, never a type of person.

signals.description: Observable things a reviewer can tick after looking at ~10 recent posts.

counter_signals.description: Observable things that point the other way. Strongly encouraged: a lens without counter-signals reads as an accusation.

reflection_prompt.description: A single question the reviewer answers for themselves. Phrase it as a question about the content or about the reviewer's own reaction.

weight.description: Always user-set. The app never ships default weights; the person decides how much each lens matters to them.

language.description: BCP-47 language tag of the lens text.
